Lemma
[The Euclidean heat-ball average is stationary] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0388 1. ch26:26.40\group Heat Balls

For a heat solution, the weighted average on the right side of Theorem 3 has zero derivative with respect to (r).

On a complete static manifold, define \[ E_r(x_0,t_0)=\{ (y,t):H(x_0,y,t_0-t)>r^{-n}\} , \qquad \psi _r=\log H+n\log r. \]
